normal.text: 今天不拿第一，我就不回去了！
normal.text_en: I'm not going home without first place!
Nice! You got me this time!

normal.text: 我的马蹄怎么突然沉了！
normal.text_en: Why do my hooves feel like lead?
Final sprint! I'm not giving an inch!

normal.text: 哈哈！现在知道谁是老大了吧！
normal.text_en: Ha! Now you know who's boss!

special.text: 别挡道！前面就是我的主场！
special.text_en: Out of my way! This track is mine!

special.text: 刚才那下？我是在让你！
special.text_en: That last move? I was letting you win!

special.text: 等等！终点是不是在那边？
special.text_en: Hang on. Is the finish over there?

special.text: 哈哈！这次是真的赢麻了！
special.text_en: Ha! Now that's what I call a win!

normal.text: 你的路线已经进入我的观察范围。

normal.text_en: That move was a little reckless.

normal.text: 你的节奏，我已经记录了。

normal.text_en: A fraction of a second too late.
No rush. The finish is still a way off.

normal.text: 进入最后阶段，开始提速。
normal.text_en: Final stage. Time to pick up the pace.

normal.text: 结果出来之前，不要下结论。
normal.text_en: Wait for the result before drawing conclusions.

special.text: 根据我的计算，你马上就要超过我了。
special.text_en: My calculations say you're about to pass me.

special.text: 你以为我不知道你要干什么？
special.text_en: You thought I hadn't planned for that?

special.text: 等一下……这不符合我的计算结果。
special.text_en: Wait. That doesn't match my calculations.

special.text: 数据更新。现在轮到我了。
special.text_en: Data updated. My turn.

normal.text: 咦？你什么时候跑到我前面了？
normal.text_en: Huh? When did you get ahead of me?
Am I even in the right lane?
What was I about to say?

special.text: 要不要跟我一起追前面那匹？
special.text_en: Want to catch the horse up front together?

special.text: 嘿嘿，我找到空当啦！
special.text_en: Hehe! I found an opening!

special.text: 我还跟得上，你等等我呀！
special.text_en: I can still keep up. Wait for me!

special.text: 等等，我刚刚问的问题是什么？
special.text_en: Wait. What did I just ask?

normal.text_en: Heh. The race has finally started.

normal.text: 你以为已经追上我了吗？

normal.text_en: Don't look back. I'm right here.
Final lap. Now it gets interesting.
Heh. That was a fun race.

special.text: 好吧好吧，这次算你赢了。
special.text_en: Fine, fine. You win this one.

special.text: 你刚才是不是看错了？
special.text_en: Are you sure you saw that right?

special.text: 嘿嘿，计划成功。
special.text_en: Hehe. Just as planned.

special.text: 要不要再猜猜，谁会赢？
special.text_en: Care to guess who'll win?

normal.text: 冠军的位置，当然属于我。
请保持优雅，我要超车了。
normal.text_en: Do keep it graceful. I'm passing.

normal.text: 金币能解决的问题，就不算问题。
normal.text_en: If gold can solve it, it isn't a problem.
A lead is hardly a victory.
You actually put me behind you?

normal.text: 奖杯已经替我准备好了。

special.text: 看看我的金币！是不是很闪？
special.text_en: Look at my coins. Don't they shine?

special.text: 想超过我？先拿出点实力吧。
special.text_en: Pass me? Show me what you can do.

special.text: 嗯？你似乎有一笔不错的交易想和我谈谈？
special.text_en: I take it you have a deal in mind?

special.text: 这就是冠军应有的排场！
special.text_en: That's how a champion makes an entrance.

riders.name: 粉骑
riders.personality: 活泼可爱、撒娇、偶尔小脾气

normal.text_en: Let's have fun out there today!

normal.text: 你是不是故意超过我的？
normal.text_en: You passed me on purpose, didn't you?

special.text: 可以稍微等我一下嘛～
special.text_en: Could you slow down just a little?

special.text: 哼！我再也不相信你了！
special.text_en: Hmph! I'm never trusting you again!

special.text: 看见了吗？这就是我的厉害！
special.text_en: See that? That's what I can do!

special.text: 这次要让你看看我的厉害！
special.text_en: I'll show you what I've got!

pink.zh:
那个……前面几位都好快。你愿意帮我一次吗？
比赛里给我一次加速。要是我拿第一，就分你一半奖金，%d 金币。说好啦？
pink.en:
Um… the others are really fast. Could you help me?
Boost me once in the race. If I win, you get half my prize: %d coins. Deal?

other.zh:
看这赔率，我得找人搭把手。
比赛里给我一次加速。要是我拿第一，就分你一半奖金，%d 金币。
other.en:
The odds are against me. I could use some help.
Boost me once in the race. If I take first, you get half my prize: %d coins.

en: Go!
Nice!
Wow!
Oops!
Haha!
Good race!

hello.zh: 紧张？我怕自己跑太快，来不及挥手！
hello.en: Nervous? I might run too fast to wave!
hello.prompt_zh: 看你一直在原地热身，赤栗已经等不及了吧？
hello.prompt_en: Warming up in place already—Chestnut cannot wait, huh?
hello.more_zh: 等一开跑，你可别走神，我三秒就冲到最前面！
hello.more_en: Do not blink at the start—I will be out front in three seconds!

joke.zh: 我刚才跟马打赌了。它说我肯定话最多。
joke.en: I made a bet with my horse. It says I talk the most.
joke.prompt_zh: 全场声音最大的就是你，喊这么多不累吗？
joke.prompt_en: Loudest voice on the whole track—not tired of shouting yet?
joke.more_zh: 气势先赢一半！等会儿在弯道上记得听我喊口号！
joke.more_en: Hype is half the win! Listen for my shout on the bend!

praise.zh: 有眼光！过线时记得再夸一遍！
praise.en: Good eye! Say that again at the finish!
praise.prompt_zh: 刚看你试跑起步，那一下冲刺真快呀！
praise.prompt_en: That launch in warmups was explosive!
praise.more_zh: 赤栗今天脚感热得很，待会儿直道上让你看个够！
praise.more_en: Chestnut is fired up today—wait till you see our straightaway!

special.zh: 先跟马击个掌。它没手，我就拍拍它。
special.en: A high five with my horse. It gets a pat instead.
special.prompt_zh: 你每次上场前都会拍拍赤栗？
special.prompt_en: Do you always pat Chestnut before the gate?
special.more_zh: 它轻轻碰我一下，我就知道今天状态满格了！
special.more_en: Once it nudges back, I know we are at full power!

snack.zh: 大口吃饭加点心！有体力才跑得最快！
snack.en: Big meal and snacks! Full energy means top speed!
snack.prompt_zh: 赤栗开跑前是不是也爱抢点心？
snack.prompt_en: Does Chestnut steal snacks before races too?
snack.more_zh: 上次它趁我不注意，连我那份点心也全吃光了！
snack.more_en: Last time it swiped my share while I looked away!

weather.zh: 大风算什么，我照样冲在最前面！
weather.en: Strong wind? I will still charge straight to first!
weather.prompt_zh: 今天赛道风这么大，赤栗稳得住吗？
weather.prompt_en: Wind is loud today—can Chestnut stay calm?
weather.more_zh: 它耳朵一甩就知道想冲了，我只抓紧缰绳！
weather.more_en: One ear flick and it wants to bolt—I just hold tight!

dream.zh: 请全场一起开心庆祝，再来一场加赛！
dream.en: Celebrate with everyone—and run another lap!
dream.prompt_zh: 要是拿了冠军，你不会又多跑半圈吧？
dream.prompt_en: If you win, will you run half an extra lap again?
dream.more_zh: 哈哈哈！那次是减速晚了，这次我多跑一整圈庆祝！
dream.more_en: Haha! I braked late that time—this time I will run a full victory lap!

lucky.zh: 大喊一声冲呀，把紧张全甩在后面！
lucky.en: Shout GO at the gate and leave all nerves behind!
lucky.prompt_zh: 你每次上场前大喊，不怕吓到旁边马吗？
lucky.prompt_en: Does shouting at the gate ever startle other horses?
lucky.more_zh: 赤栗听见我喊反而更稳，我们脾气一个样！
lucky.more_en: Chestnut actually steadies up when I yell—we are just alike!

rival.prompt_zh: 这几名对手里，你最想赢谁？
rival.prompt_en: Which rival do you want to beat the most?
rival.zh: 蓝骑老爱算数据，我偏要在弯道把他的计划全冲乱！
rival.en: Blue loves his numbers—I want to wreck his whole plan on the bend!
rival.more_zh: 对了，要是别人再问红建国是谁，帮我告诉他们别乱起外号！
rival.more_en: And if anyone asks who Hong Jianguo is, tell them to cut it out!

story.prompt_zh: 你最初是怎么和赤栗一起跑的？
story.prompt_en: How did you first partner with Chestnut?
story.zh: 它以前谁都不让骑，结果把我甩下来三次还冲我打气！
story.en: Nobody could ride it—it threw me three times and snorted at me.
story.more_zh: 第四次我没松手，它就认了我。这脾气，绝配！
story.more_en: Fourth try I held on, and we clicked. Perfect match!

hello.zh: 心率比平时高一点。还在可控范围。
hello.en: My pulse is a little high. Still within range.
hello.prompt_zh: 开跑前还在看笔记，这轮方案算好了？
hello.prompt_en: Still checking notes before the gate—plan locked in?
hello.more_zh: 前半程稳住内线，后程按节奏发力，误差不到半秒。
hello.more_en: Hold inside early, unleash late—margin under half a second.

joke.zh: 我有个笑话。统计上，它应该很好笑。
joke.en: I have a joke. Statistically, it should be funny.
joke.prompt_zh: 你的秒表要是慢了一格，比赛还跑不跑？
joke.prompt_en: If your stopwatch lags a tick, do you still race?
joke.more_zh: 我会先调准，再把那零点一秒在弯道里追回来。
joke.more_en: Recalibrate first, then win that tenth of a second back in the turn.

praise.zh: 谢谢。我刚把出弯点向前挪了半步。
praise.en: Thanks. I moved my exit point half a step earlier.
praise.prompt_zh: 刚才看苍影过弯几乎没减速，太稳了。
praise.prompt_en: Shadow barely lost any speed on that warmup bend.
praise.more_zh: 步幅和入弯时机刚好吻合。谢谢你的观察。
praise.more_en: Stride cadence matched the entry timing. Thank you for noticing.

special.zh: 我会再检查一次缰绳和起步路线。
special.en: I check the reins and my starting line one more time.
special.prompt_zh: 上场前你总要静下来想一会儿，是在默记路线？
special.prompt_en: Pausing quietly before every race—rehearsing the line?
special.more_zh: 把每个弯道和可能的变道在心里跑一遍，上场就不慌。
special.more_en: Running every bend and lane shift mentally keeps race pace calm.

snack.zh: 少量点心就好。状态稳定比什么都重要。
snack.en: Just a light snack. Steady focus matters most.
snack.prompt_zh: 你连赛前吃什么都要按数据算吗？
snack.prompt_en: Do you even calculate your pre-race snacks?
snack.more_zh: 不多不少刚好够跑完最后一圈，零浪费。
snack.more_en: Just enough energy for the final lap, zero waste.

weather.zh: 弯道风向我已经算进换道路线里了。
weather.en: Bend wind is already factored into my lane plan.
weather.prompt_zh: 你刚才盯着赛道看了半天，在算风速？
weather.prompt_en: Were you timing the wind on the track earlier?
weather.more_zh: 嗯，第二个弯道外侧阻力偏大，我会提前切内线。
weather.more_en: Yes—outer bend drag is higher today, so I will cut inside early.

dream.zh: 整理这八轮数据，为下一次比赛做准备。
dream.en: Archive all eight rounds of data for the next cup.
dream.prompt_zh: 拿了总冠军，你会放松休息一天吗？
dream.prompt_en: If you win the cup, will you take a day off?
dream.more_zh: 也许会先静静休息，再把最后一圈复盘一遍。
dream.more_en: Maybe one quiet pause—then review the final lap split.

lucky.zh: 开跑前默数三秒，重新确认起步节奏。
lucky.en: Count three quietly and recheck my start rhythm.
lucky.prompt_zh: 你真的不看手气，只看计时表吗？
lucky.prompt_en: Do you really ignore luck and only trust the clock?
lucky.more_zh: 苍影出弯放长步幅的那一刻，就是最好的手气。
lucky.more_en: When Shadow lengthens its exit stride, that is all the luck I need.

rival.prompt_zh: 你的笔记里，谁最让人看不住？
rival.prompt_en: In your notes, who is hardest to read?
rival.zh: 绿骑。偶尔数错圈数，反而会在意想不到的地方加速。
rival.en: Green. Loses lap count and accelerates where no model expects.
rival.more_zh: 至于紫骑，他喜欢等人回头，只要不看他就能稳住。
rival.more_en: As for Purple, he waits for you to glance back—so never look.

story.prompt_zh: 那场让你开始记笔记的录像，后来你还看过吗？
story.prompt_en: Do you still watch that first race tape?
story.zh: 留着呢。那时候我以为自己很快，结果全程都在白费力气。
story.en: I kept it. I thought I was flying, yet I wasted every stride.
story.more_zh: 苍影一直很耐心，等我慢慢学会听它的节奏。
story.more_en: Shadow was patient while I finally learned to listen to its rhythm.

hello.zh: 有一点！你一问，我反而没那么紧张了。
hello.en: A little! Now that you ask, I feel better.
hello.prompt_zh: 别忘了这轮有几圈呀，准备好了吗？
hello.prompt_en: Remember the lap count this round—ready to roll?
hello.more_zh: 这次我把圈数记住啦，绝对不会再多跑一圈！
hello.more_en: Memorized the lap count this time—no extra lap mistakes!

joke.zh: 嘿嘿！我想了个笑话……开头是什么来着？
joke.en: Hehe! I thought of a joke… how did it start?
joke.prompt_zh: 听说银风比你还会认终点线？
joke.prompt_en: Heard Silver spots the finish line better than you?
joke.more_zh: 嘿嘿，真的！每次到最后一圈它都会先点头提醒我！
joke.more_en: Hehe, true! It gives me a little nod on the bell lap to remind me!

praise.zh: 真的呀？我刚才还以为自己走错道了！
praise.en: Really? I thought I'd taken the wrong lane!
praise.prompt_zh: 银风刚才绕场跑得好轻快，像顺着风一样！
praise.prompt_en: Silver looked light as a breeze out there!
praise.more_zh: 听见你夸它，银风高兴得直甩头呢！
praise.more_en: Silver is tossing its head happily hearing that!

special.zh: 摸四叶草。偶尔会摸了三次才想起来。
special.en: I touch my clover. Sometimes I do it three times by accident.
special.prompt_zh: 你每次都会轻轻跟银风碰碰额头？
special.prompt_en: Do you always lean in to touch foreheads with Silver first?
special.more_zh: 嗯！这样它就知道今天是开心跑比赛，不是赶路啦！
special.more_en: Yep! That tells it we are racing for fun, not chores!

snack.zh: 最喜欢吃小点心啦！银风刚才也想偷吃呢。
snack.en: Little snacks! Silver tried to sneak a bite too.
snack.prompt_zh: 银风今天是不是又盯着你手里看？
snack.prompt_en: Is Silver staring at your hands again today?
snack.more_zh: 对呀！它记性可好了，放哪儿都能被它找到！
snack.more_en: Yes! It remembers every single treat I try to hide!

weather.zh: 有风跑起来好开心呀，感觉马都变轻了！
weather.en: The breeze feels great—makes us feel lighter!
weather.prompt_zh: 今天天气这么好，你不会跑着跑着看风景吧？
weather.prompt_en: With weather this nice, will you forget to watch the lane?
weather.more_zh: 才不会呢！……应该不会吧，银风会提醒我的！
weather.more_en: No way! ...Probably not—Silver will nudge me if I do!

dream.zh: 带银风去草地跑一圈，好好放松一下！
dream.en: Take Silver for a relaxing run on the grass!
dream.prompt_zh: 要是赢了这么多金币，你想带银风去哪？
dream.prompt_en: With all that prize gold, where will you take Silver?
dream.more_zh: 找一片大草地，不计时也不抢道，想跑几圈就跑几圈！
dream.more_en: A wide open meadow—no clock, no traffic, just running free!

lucky.zh: 对着四叶草许愿，希望大家都平平安安！
lucky.en: Wish on my clover that everyone finishes safely!
lucky.prompt_zh: 你的四叶草今天带在身上了吗？
lucky.prompt_en: Did you bring your four-leaf clover today?
lucky.more_zh: 带啦！我出发前还让银风闻了一下，它开心地甩了甩头！
lucky.more_en: Right here! I let Silver sniff it and it tossed its head happily!

rival.prompt_zh: 你觉得场上哪位骑手最不好追？
rival.prompt_en: Who is the toughest rider for you to chase?
rival.zh: 红骑冲起来像一把火，我一转眼就看不见人影了！
rival.en: Red charges like a fireball—one blink and he is gone!
rival.more_zh: 不过只要顺着风贴紧弯道，我和银风也能追上去！
rival.more_en: Still, if we ride the breeze around the bend, Silver and I can catch up!

story.prompt_zh: 家里人教你骑马时，最常说什么？
story.prompt_en: What did your family tell you when you learned to ride?
story.zh: 别急着赶马跑，先伸手让它闻闻，心意相通才会一起赢。
story.en: Never rush a horse—hold out your hand first. Trust wins together.
story.more_zh: 银风第一次就是轻轻贴近我的手心，所以我一直记得！
story.more_en: Silver gently nudged my palm that first day, and I never forgot!

hello.zh: 有一点。呵呵，不过听见你这么问，我就放心了。
hello.en: A little. Hehe, hearing you ask puts me at ease.
hello.prompt_zh: 你站得这么靠边，又在打什么弯道主意？
hello.prompt_en: Standing off to the side—plotting another bend trick?
hello.more_zh: 别紧张，真正的好戏要留到最后半圈才开场。
hello.more_en: Relax—the real show waits until the final half lap.

joke.zh: 我打赌你猜不到我早饭吃了什么。是布丁。
joke.en: Bet you can't guess my breakfast. It was pudding.
joke.prompt_zh: 待会儿换道前，你能先给我个信号吗？
joke.prompt_en: Give me a signal before you cut lanes later?
joke.more_zh: 好呀，等我超到你前面时，再回头告诉你。
joke.more_en: Sure—I will glance back and tell you right after I pass.

praise.zh: 哦？你也注意到了。那我下次可要认真一点。
praise.en: Oh? You noticed. Now I'll have to try a bit harder.
praise.prompt_zh: 你刚才那招切内线，差点把我看花眼了。
praise.prompt_en: That inside feint earlier almost faked me out.
praise.more_zh: 呵呵，只是热身的小把戏。真跑起来会更好看。
praise.more_en: Heh, just a warmup tease. The real race gets much sharper.

special.zh: 我会听起跑线边的脚步声，数到第三下就安静下来。
special.en: I listen for footsteps near the start. Three steps and I settle down.
special.prompt_zh: 你开跑前总爱盯着别人眼神看，干嘛呢？
special.prompt_en: Why do you stare into everyone eyes before the gate?
special.more_zh: 看谁眼神一直乱看，谁就最容易在弯道留出空位。
special.more_en: Whoever has wandering eyes leaves the widest gap in the turn.

snack.zh: 来一点布丁就够了，正好保持清醒。
snack.en: Just a little pudding—keeps my mind sharp.
snack.prompt_en: Did you have pudding for breakfast again?
snack.more_zh: 呵呵，被你记住了呢。布丁能让我在弯道更冷静。
snack.more_en: Heh, you remembered. Pudding keeps me calm through the bends.

weather.zh: 风大才好，对手更容易给出空当呢。
weather.en: Strong wind makes rivals easier to read.
weather.prompt_zh: 风这么大，你的换道招数还灵吗？
weather.prompt_en: Will your lane feints still work in this wind?
weather.more_zh: 局面一乱，大家就更容易看错方向，正合我意。
weather.more_en: The messier the pack gets, the easier everyone misreads a move.

dream.zh: 呵呵，最想看大家在终点停住的一刻。
dream.en: Heh, watching everyone freeze at the finish.
dream.prompt_zh: 你来比赛好像不只为了金币？
dream.prompt_en: You seem to race for more than just coins.
dream.more_zh: 金币当然好，可最后半圈反超时的安静，才最让人上瘾。
dream.more_en: Gold is nice, yet that split second of silence when I slip past? Priceless.

lucky.zh: 仔细观察每个人的起跑站位，很有意思哦。
lucky.prompt_zh: 你上场前总在偷笑，又想到新主意了？
lucky.prompt_en: That smirk before the gate—another scheme ready?
lucky.more_zh: 秘密。待会儿在赛道上，你很快就会见到。
lucky.more_en: Secret. You will see it on the track soon enough.

rival.prompt_en: Who is the most fun to outsmart?
rival.zh: 黄骑。他最在意风度，只要抢在他前面切线，他表情最有趣。
rival.en: Gold. He cares so much about poise—cutting his line is priceless.
rival.more_zh: 不过你也慢慢变得不好骗了，这样才好玩嘛。
rival.more_en: Though you are getting harder to fool too—makes it even more fun.

story.prompt_zh: 听说你刚上场时总被人挤到外道？
story.prompt_en: Heard you used to get boxed outside on debut?
story.zh: 是啊，那时候只顾着往前挤，连着输了好几场。
story.en: True—I tried forcing my way through and lost race after race.
story.more_zh: 直到黑曜自己停了一拍，从内侧空位钻过去，我才明白。
story.more_en: Until Onyx waited half a beat and slipped inside. That taught me everything.

hello.zh: 有一丝紧张也无妨。把手套戴好，自然就镇定了。
hello.en: A little nerves never hurt. Once my gloves are on, I'm calm.
hello.prompt_zh: 你看起来一点不慌，这轮打算全场领跑？
hello.prompt_en: Looking calm as ever—planning to lead wire to wire?
hello.more_zh: 领跑当然亮眼，优雅地赢下终点线才是真本事。
hello.more_en: Leading is flashy; winning the line with grace is true mastery.

joke.zh: 有趣的是，我比奖杯更早准备好了领奖台词。
joke.en: Here's something amusing. My podium speech was ready before the trophy.
joke.prompt_zh: 要是赛道草叶飞起来，你会减速躲开吗？
joke.prompt_en: If track grass kicks up, would you slow to dodge it?
joke.more_zh: 只要始终跑在最前面，就不会有任何草叶落在身上。
joke.more_en: Stay in first place and not a single speck can reach you.

praise.zh: 你眼光不错。下次我会跑得更优雅。
praise.en: You have a good eye. Next time I'll be even more graceful.
praise.prompt_zh: 刚才看你和金麦入场，看台欢呼声最大呢。
praise.prompt_en: You and Goldie got the loudest cheer entering the track.
praise.more_zh: 观众懂得看从容的步调，这轮我也不会让他们失望。
praise.more_en: The crowd appreciates composed stride—I will not disappoint them.

special.zh: 把手套拉平、披风理好。比赛也要讲究仪态。
special.en: I smooth my gloves and straighten my cape. Poise matters.
special.prompt_zh: 每次进场你都会先向看台挥手？
special.prompt_en: Do you always wave to the stands before every race?
special.more_zh: 礼数到位，比赛才更有分量。金麦也很喜欢那份掌声。
special.more_en: Proper form elevates the race—and Goldie loves the applause.

snack.zh: 好看的点心配好心情，赛前也要保持优雅。
snack.en: Fine treats and poise—elegance starts before the gate.
snack.prompt_zh: 连赛前休息，你也要这么讲究吗？
snack.prompt_en: Even pre-race breaks have to be this fancy?
snack.more_zh: 心态决定了步调，从容的人才能笑到终点。
snack.more_en: Poise sets the pace—only the composed smile at the finish.

weather.zh: 这点风刚好，跑起来更有冠军的排场。
weather.en: Just enough breeze for a champion entrance.
weather.prompt_zh: 今天的风会不会弄乱金麦的鬃毛？
weather.prompt_en: Will the wind mess up Goldie mane today?
weather.more_zh: 放心，出发前我仔细理过三遍，一根都不会乱。
weather.more_en: Relax—I combed it three times before the gate. Not a strand out of place.

dream.zh: 把奖杯高高举起来，让全场都记住我。
dream.en: Hold the trophy high so the whole stadium remembers.
dream.prompt_zh: 如果今天站上领奖台，第一句话想说什么？
dream.prompt_en: If you take the podium today, what will you say first?
dream.more_zh: 当然是谢谢金麦，再顺便提醒大家，优雅也能赢比赛。
dream.more_en: Thank Goldie first—and remind the crowd that elegance wins too.

lucky.zh: 调整好状态再上场，冠军可不能乱了风度。
lucky.en: Check my poise before mounting—style matters.
lucky.prompt_zh: 你每次都会替金麦理鬃毛再上场？
lucky.prompt_en: Do you always comb Goldie mane before every race?
lucky.more_zh: 这是我们的约定，理顺了它跑起来才会拿出全部实力。
lucky.more_en: Our unspoken deal—once it is neat, Goldie gives me everything.

rival.prompt_zh: 场上有哪位对手让你觉得值得认真对待？
rival.prompt_en: Which rival truly earns your respect?
rival.zh: 蓝骑的节奏很稳，紫骑的心思够细，都是不错的对手。
rival.en: Blue has steady pacing and Purple is sharp—worthy rivals both.
rival.more_zh: 至于你嘛，如果你能在终点前追上我，我也会为你鼓掌。
rival.more_en: As for you, catch me before the line and I will gladly applaud.

story.prompt_zh: 你刚才说，以前只想站在看台看得见的地方？
story.prompt_en: You once said you just wanted to be seen from the stands?
story.zh: 小时候总觉得，只有站在最亮的位置才算被记住。
story.en: Growing up, I thought only the brightest spot mattered.
story.more_zh: 后来和金麦跑过那么多圈才懂，跑出自己的节奏才最亮眼。
story.more_en: After so many laps with Goldie, I learned running true to yourself shines brightest.

hello.zh: 有一点点！再跟我说声加油嘛。
hello.en: A teeny bit! Tell me good luck?
hello.prompt_zh: 今天花斑的脚步看着好轻快，状态不错吧？
hello.prompt_en: Patches looks so bouncy today—feeling good?
hello.more_zh: 嗯！它刚才还冲我点点头呢，我们这轮一定会跑完最棒的一场！
hello.more_en: Yes! It even nodded at me—we are going to give our best run!

joke.zh: 我刚和小马说别紧张。然后它回头看了我一眼！
joke.en: I told my horse to relax. Then it looked right back at me!
joke.prompt_zh: 你身上的小爱心，是不是每次赛前都擦得发亮？
joke.prompt_en: Do you polish the little heart on your helmet every round?
joke.more_zh: 嘿嘿，被你发现啦！这么亮眼，栏杆那边的人一眼就能找到我！
joke.more_en: Hehe, caught me! Shiny means my fans by the rail can spot me!

praise.zh: 嘿嘿，再说一遍嘛，我爱听！
praise.en: Hehe, say it again! I love hearing that!
praise.prompt_zh: 刚才看你和花斑配合得真好，一点都不慌！
praise.prompt_en: You and Patches looked totally in sync just now!
praise.more_zh: 谢谢你！听你这么一说，我感觉整个人都更有劲啦！
praise.more_en: Thank you! Hearing that gives me a huge boost!

special.zh: 我会给小马偷偷比个心。你可别说出去！
special.en: I make a little heart for my horse. Keep it a secret!
special.prompt_zh: 上场前你总要给花斑顺顺耳朵？
special.prompt_en: Always smoothing Patches ears before heading out?
special.more_zh: 只要摸摸耳朵，它就不怕开跑时的声音了，可灵啦！
special.more_en: One gentle ear rub and the starting bell does not spook it at all!

snack.zh: 带了好多小点心！分你一半，一起加油吧！
snack.en: Brought plenty of treats! Here is half—let us go!
snack.prompt_zh: 花斑今天心情看起来真好呢！
snack.more_zh: 嘿嘿，因为我带了它最喜欢的小点心，分了它两份！
snack.more_en: Hehe, I brought its favorite snacks and shared two pieces!

weather.zh: 花瓣跟着风飞起来，赛道变得好好看呀！
weather.en: Petals fly in the wind—the track looks so pretty!
weather.prompt_zh: 赛道起风了，花斑会不会有点紧张？
weather.prompt_en: Track is windy—is Patches getting nervous?
weather.more_zh: 有一点点，不过我摸摸它的耳朵，它马上就安心啦！
weather.more_en: Just a tiny bit, but once I pat its ears it calms right down!

dream.zh: 给花斑准备最漂亮的小红花，带它去玩！
dream.en: Get Patches the prettiest flower and go play!
dream.prompt_zh: 拿了冠军你想先和谁一起庆祝？
dream.prompt_en: Who will you celebrate with first if you win?
dream.more_zh: 先抱抱花斑，再去栏杆旁边和一直给我们加油的人比心！
dream.more_en: Hug Patches first, then make hearts to our fans by the rail!

lucky.zh: 轻轻拍拍花斑，告诉它放轻松别紧张！
lucky.en: Pat Patches gently and tell it not to be nervous!
lucky.prompt_zh: 你开跑前总在和花斑小声说话？
lucky.prompt_en: Are you always whispering to Patches before the gate?
lucky.more_zh: 嗯！我会问它准备好了吗，它点点头我们再一起冲！
lucky.more_en: Yep! I ask if it is ready, and we wait for its little nod!

rival.prompt_zh: 前面几位跑得那么快，你不怕吗？
rival.prompt_en: The others charge so hard—does it scare you?
rival.zh: 起初会有点怕，可花斑很稳，后半程很有劲！
rival.en: A little at first, yet Patches is steady and gets stronger late!
rival.more_zh: 要是你在旁边一起跑，我就一点都不紧张啦！
rival.more_en: And if you are racing nearby, I do not feel nervous at all!

story.prompt_zh: 栏杆旁那几位给你鼓掌的人，后来还来吗？
story.prompt_en: Do those fans by the rail still come cheer for you?
story.zh: 每次都来呢！哪怕我第一场没进前三，他们也喊得好大声。
story.en: Every single race! Even when I missed top three, they cheered so loud.
story.more_zh: 所以我答应过花斑，一定要带他们看一次我们拿第一！
story.more_en: So I promised Patches we would show them a first-place finish!

chat_replies: 这个表情还能这样用呀？
chat_replies_en: Ha! See you at the finish!
Emote received. Back to the race.
I came to the same conclusion.
You can use that emote like that?
Oh? Say it again, dare you.
Keep smiling. I'm about to pass.
Save the celebration for the finish.
A little louder with that applause.
Wow, you like that one too?

passed.zh: 借过！后面有我的蹄印，照着追！
我说三二一……好，我先跑了！
passed.en: Three, two, one… I'm already gone!

overtake.en: I was busy counting the crowd!

overtake.zh: 好家伙，你从哪儿钻过去的？
overtake.en: Whoa! Where did you slip through?

ai_counter.en: Right back at you. You're welcome!

counter_ok.en: Nice! I'll give you that one!
Huh? When did you learn that?

trap.en: Go on! Here's a little push!

trap.zh: 看路看路，前头可热闹了！
trap.en: Eyes up! It's crowded up there!

trap.zh: 借你点速度，看你往哪儿拐！
trap.en: How about some speed? Where will you turn?

passed.zh: 你的外侧空了半个马身。
passed.en: You left half a length open outside.

passed.zh: 现在按第二套方案执行。

overtake.en: I picked the entry too late.

overtake.zh: 预留的空位比想象中大。
overtake.en: The opening was wider than I thought.

ai_counter.zh: 数据更新。现在轮到我了。
记录一下，这一招已经失效。
ai_counter.en: For the record, that move stopped working.

counter_ok.zh: 你比我预计的早了一拍。
counter_ok.en: You reacted a beat sooner than I expected.

counter_ok.zh: 可复现吗？我想再观察一次。
counter_ok.en: Can you do that again? I'd like to see it.

trap.zh: 前方拥堵。你还敢提速吗？
trap.en: Traffic ahead. Still want to speed up?

trap.zh: 这条线的空位只剩一个。
trap.en: There's only one opening in that line.

trap.zh: 来验证一下你的换道速度。
trap.en: Let's test how quickly you can change lanes.

passed.en: Hehe! I'll lead the way this time!

passed.zh: 我本来只是想看一眼前面！
passed.en: I only meant to take a peek ahead!

overtake.zh: 等等！你怎么又在前面了？
overtake.en: Wait! How are you ahead again?
Did I take the wrong lane again?
I've got it! Go first… then what?

ai_counter.zh: 诶？按对了！我自己都吓一跳！
ai_counter.en: I got it! Even I was surprised!

ai_counter.zh: 这题我会！不是，我是说这招！
ai_counter.en: I know this answer! I mean this move!

counter_ok.en: Wow, you know that trick too!

counter_ok.zh: 好快！刚才那个你看清了吗？
counter_ok.en: So fast! Did you see that clearly?

counter_ok.zh: 等等，我刚才是要攻击你吗？
counter_ok.en: Wait. Was I trying to hit you?

trap.en: Oh! Can you switch lanes in time?

trap.zh: 慢着，前面那匹是不是没看见你？
trap.en: Wait, has that horse ahead seen you?

trap.zh: 其实我也不知道哪边有空！
trap.en: I don't know which lane is clear either!

passed.zh: 别回头哦，我已经在前面了。
passed.en: Don't look back. I'm already ahead.
Hehe, you watched the wrong lane.

passed.zh: 刚才我在放你过去。猜猜现在呢？
passed.en: I let you through earlier. Guess what now?

overtake.en: Heh. You caught me off guard.

overtake.zh: 前面当心。知道为什么吗？
overtake.en: Careful up there. Want to know why?

overtake.zh: 这么快就把我的位置拿走了？
overtake.en: You took my place that easily?

ai_counter.zh: 呵呵，这一步我早猜到了。
ai_counter.en: Hehe. I saw that move coming.
Wait half a beat. Then you might have a chance.
Thanks for bringing me an opening.

counter_ok.zh: 有意思，你竟然忍到那一刻。
counter_ok.en: Interesting. You waited until the last moment.
You saw through it? Time for a different trick.

trap.zh: 前面很挤，我偏想送你一程。
trap.en: It's crowded ahead. Let me give you a push.

trap.zh: 选一边吧。我可没说哪边是空的。
trap.en: Pick a side. I never said either was clear.

passed.zh: 请保持优雅，我要领先了。
passed.en: Stay graceful. I'm taking the lead.

passed.zh: 这才是冠军该走的路线。
麻烦让一下，我的披风要过去。
passed.en: Make way. My cape is coming through.

overtake.en: Hmph. You can borrow my spot.
Fine. That was a clean pass.

ai_counter.zh: 这种小动作可拦不住我。
你也该学学什么叫从容。
ai_counter.en: You could learn a little poise.

ai_counter.zh: 听见掌声了吗？是给我的。
ai_counter.en: Hear that applause? That's for me.

counter_ok.zh: 这份时机拿捏，勉强及格。
看得出你至少有认真练。
counter_ok.en: I can tell you've been practicing.

trap.en: Try it, if you can find an opening.

trap.zh: 赶路也讲排场，你准备好了吗？
trap.en: A proper charge needs style. Ready?

trap.zh: 前面的位置可没替你留。
trap.en: Nobody kept that spot ahead for you.

passed.en: Hehe, your turn to chase me!
Hey! Now's the time to praise me!
Who was going to wait for me?

overtake.zh: 哇，你跑得好快！等等我嘛～
overtake.en: Wow! You're fast. Wait for me!
Hmph! You got a jump on me!

overtake.zh: 刚才没准备好，再来一次嘛！
overtake.en: I wasn't ready! One more go?

ai_counter.zh: 吓到我啦！不过我接住了！
ai_counter.en: You scared me! But I got it!
Did you see? I didn't panic at all!

counter_ok.zh: 哼！你怎么一下就接住啦？
counter_ok.en: Hmph! How did you time that so well?

counter_ok.zh: 好吧，有一点帅。只有一点哦！
counter_ok.en: Okay, that was a little cool. Just a little!

counter_ok.zh: 哎呀，下次能让我也试试吗？
counter_ok.en: Aww, can I try that next time?

trap.zh: 送你一小段加速，接好啦！
你躲得开吧？可别记我仇呀！
trap.en: You'll dodge it, right? Don't hold a grudge!

zh: 太过瘾了！我本来想留力，听到观众一喊，脚先动了。
下场见。记得别在最后一段给我留空位！
en: Was that a good race?
A blast! I meant to save energy. Then the crowd roared and off I went.
See you next time. Don't leave me an opening on the home stretch!

zh: 看别人盯哪边。我先晃一下，再从他没看的那边溜过去。
不过这招只能用一次。第二次……就得装自己也不知道往哪跑！
en: Where do you look before a pass?
Wherever they're looking. I feint, then slip past on the other side.
It only works once. Next time I pretend I don't know where I'm going!

zh: 练习领奖表情！先冷静三秒，再忍不住笑。
别跟别人说，我连没拿奖时的表情也练过。
en: What do you do before a race?
Practice my podium face. Stay cool for three seconds, then grin.
Don't tell anyone, but I practice my losing face too.

zh: 它一甩耳朵，我就知道它闲不住了。
我一笑，它也知道我想加速。挺公平！
en: How do you work with Chestnut?
One flick of its ears and I know it's ready to go.
One grin from me and it knows I want a boost. Fair enough!

zh: 你第一次上场记得什么？
记得我冲过了线，还多跑了半圈。
那时比今天还爱出风头。好吧，差不多！
en: What do you remember from your first race?
I crossed the finish and ran half a lap more.
I was even more of a show-off back then. Well, about the same.

zh: 出发比预期快，中段有两次换道浪费了距离。
终点前那段倒值得记下来。别人会变，路线可以复盘。
en: How would you rate the race?
The start was faster than expected. Two lane changes cost me distance.
I'd review the home stretch. Rivals change. You can still study the lines.

zh: 前面至少要有一段能跑开的空位。光看距离还不够。
留一手，等最前面那匹的路线确定了再出手。
en: When do you decide to boost?
When there's room to run. Distance alone isn't enough.
Save a charge until you see which line the leader takes.

zh: 没有。点晚饭时我只做三项评分。
味道、价格，以及吃完还能不能跑。
en: Are you always this serious?
No. I score dinner on only three criteria.
Taste, price, and whether I can still run afterward.

zh: 出弯时它会把步幅放长。我等那一步才动。
最早是我在教它。后来发现，它也在教我。
en: What cue does Shadow give you?
It lengthens a stride at the exit. I move on that step.
At first I was teaching it. Then I realised it was teaching me too.

zh: 你为什么开始记每场比赛？
第一场跑完只记得自己很快。录像说刚好相反。
后来我学会把感觉和计时放在一起看。
en: Why do you record every race?
I remembered being fast in my first race. The replay disagreed.
Now I compare what I felt with the clock.

zh: 大家突然挤到一起的时候！我想跟过去，又忘了要跟谁。
最后我盯着自己那条道跑，居然就顺了。
en: What was the most fun part?
When everyone bunched up! I wanted to follow, then forgot who to follow.
In the end I watched my own lane and it all worked out.

zh: 因为我会数还有几个弯。数错就只好再数一遍。
不过别只看脚下哦，前面有空位的时候最容易错过。
en: Why do you smile coming out of a bend?
I count how many turns are left. If I get it wrong, I count again.
But look ahead too. An open lane can be easy to miss.

zh: 有！为什么赛马不戴手表？因为它只有蹄表！
诶，你怎么没笑？等我重新想一个！
en: Did you have fun out there?
Why don't horses wear watches? They can't keep their hooves on the hands!
Wait, you didn't laugh. Let me think of another!

zh: 银风吧。它总知道我什么时候在数错圈。
我紧张时就拍拍它，它会把耳朵转向我。
en: Who has the better instincts, you or Silver?
Silver. It always knows when I've lost count.
When I'm nervous I pat it. It turns an ear toward me.

zh: 家里人先教我怎么让马愿意靠近。
我到现在还记得，得先伸手等它闻。
en: Who first taught you to ride?
My family taught me how to let a horse come to me.
I still remember to hold out my hand and let it sniff.

zh: 你是不是一直在等我先加速？
呵呵，急着冲的人，通常顾不上看后面。
不过这次你回头看了一眼。下次我得换个地方等。
en: Were you waiting for me to boost first?
Hehe. Riders in a hurry rarely watch behind them.
You did look back this time. I'll have to wait somewhere else.

zh: 你为什么有时故意让出内侧？
让你看到一条好走的道，总比让你看见我在做什么容易。
下次有条道突然空出来，记得先看看它通往哪里。
en: Why do you sometimes give up the inside?
It's easier to let you see an open lane than to let you see my plan.
Next time a lane opens, check where it leads.

zh: 笑你认真猜我在想什么。
这次告诉你吧。我在想休息室还有没有布丁。
en: What are you always smiling at?
How hard you try to guess what I'm thinking.
I'll tell you this time. I wonder if there's pudding left.

zh: 黑曜也和你一样爱留一手吗？
它只在看见空道时才动。比我耐心多了。
呵呵，你以为那些招数都是我想的吗？
en: Does Onyx hold back a trick too?
It only moves when it sees an opening. More patient than I am.
Hehe. You thought all those tricks were mine?

zh: 你什么时候学会骗道的？
刚上场时我总被人挤出去。后来我学会等。
等到那个人回头，空位就来了。
en: When did you learn to feint?
I used to get pushed wide. Then I learned to wait.
Once they look back, the opening appears.

zh: 这场有让你意外的地方吗？
最后一段的掌声比我预期的大。你跑得也比我想的稳。
当然，掌声究竟是给谁的，下次再见分晓。
en: Did anything surprise you?
The applause was louder than I expected. Your ride was steadier, too.
As for who they were cheering for, we'll see next time.

zh: 你怎么找出弯的超车机会？
我先盯出口，等前面的马把路线跑直再动。
抢一点位置可以。把我的披风挤乱就免谈。
en: How do you find a pass out of a turn?
Watch the exit. Move once the horse ahead straightens out.
Taking a gap is fine. Wrinkling my cape is not.

zh: 你为什么总记得每座奖杯？
当然记得。每一座都提醒我赢的是哪一场。
而且擦亮它们比数金币麻烦多了。
en: How do you remember every trophy?
Each one reminds me which race I won.
And polishing them takes much longer than counting coins.

zh: 喜欢我替它把鬃毛梳齐。一根乱发也会甩头。
所以别笑我的仪态，它对自己比我还严格。
en: What does Goldie like before a race?
A tidy mane. One stray hair and it shakes its head.
Don't laugh about my poise. It's stricter than I am.

zh: 你小时候就想拿奖杯吗？
起先只是想站在看台也看得见的地方。
后来明白，得先跑给自己看。
en: Did you want trophies as a kid?
At first I just wanted people in the stands to see me.
Later I learned to race for myself first.

zh: 刚才是不是差一点就追上了？
我都听见你的马蹄声了！还是忍住没回头，我很厉害吧？
下次你要是看见我冲过来，记得帮我喊一声加油哦！
en: Did you nearly catch up there?
I heard your hoofbeats! I still didn't look back. Pretty good, right?
Next time you see me coming, cheer for me, okay?

zh: 你最后那一下为什么走外道？
因为前面挤得我都快把马尾碰到了！外面绕远一点，至少能跑开。
哼，我也是会想办法的。快夸我！
en: Why did you go wide at the end?
I was almost on someone's tail! The outside was longer, but I had room to move.
Hmph. I can plan too. Go on, praise me!

zh: 今天收到最喜欢的表情是什么？
当然是爱心！不过你要是发个大笑，我也会笑回来。
还有，不准拿打瞌睡的那个回我！
en: What was your favorite emote today?
Hearts, obviously! But if you send a laugh, I'll laugh back.
And don't you dare send me the sleepy one!

zh: 花斑会认出你的声音吗？
会呀！我一小声说加油，它就竖起耳朵。
当然，我也会等它点点头再出发。
en: Does Patches know your voice?
Of course! I whisper good luck and its ears prick up.
And I wait for a little nod before we go.

zh: 你第一次跑完最想找谁？
我想找在栏杆旁对我比心的人！
那时我没上领奖台，可他们还是给我鼓掌。
en: Who did you look for after your first race?
The person making a heart by the rail!
I missed the podium, but they cheered for me anyway.

hello.en: Race is about to start. Feeling nervous?

praise.zh: 你今天热身跑得很漂亮。
praise.en: You looked great in warmups today.

snack.zh: 赛前你平时吃什么保持状态？
snack.en: What do you eat before a race?

weather.zh: 今天赛道风好大，有关系吗？
weather.en: Wind feels strong today. Any trouble?

dream.zh: 拿了冠军你最想做什么？
dream.en: What will you do if you win it all?

lucky.zh: 你有什么开跑前的小习惯吗？

rival.zh: 这几位对手里，你最在意谁？
rival.en: Which rival are you watching most?

story.zh: 能聊聊你和马以前的往事吗？
story.en: Care to share a story about you and your horse?

win.zh: 现在你知道谁是老大了吧？

loss.zh: 哎呀！下回我可要追回来！
loss.en: Aw! I'll catch you next time!
This one's yours! See you next time!

win.zh: 路线有效。第一名已确认。

win.en: Pace on target. Result as expected.

loss.zh: 出弯晚了半拍。回去复盘。
loss.en: Half a beat late at the exit. Time to review.
Log the error. Adjust next time.

win.en: Hehe! I counted my laps right!

loss.zh: 差一点！我还想再跑一圈。
loss.en: So close! I want another lap.

loss.zh: 下次出弯我可要看仔细啦。
loss.en: I'll watch the exit next time.

win.en: See you at the finish. I told you so.

loss.en: Heh. You can laugh first this time.

loss.zh: 你看穿一招。我还有别的。
loss.en: You saw through one trick. I have others.

win.zh: 请把掌声留到我行礼之后。
win.en: Hold your applause until I've bowed.

loss.en: You earned that applause this time.
Next time I'll win with more grace.

win.zh: 知道本姑娘的厉害了吧～
win.en: Now you know what I can do!
Yay! You promised to praise me!

loss.zh: 下次我会追上你的，真的！
loss.en: I'll catch you next time. Really!

red_reply.en: I'm not playing with you anymore!

en: Make room! I'm taking the lead!
Who wants to race the next stretch?

zh: 保持间距。下一段还有空位。
en: Keep a gap. There's room ahead.
Easy. Save the boost for the exit.

zh: 你也在数还剩几个弯吗？
en: Are you counting the turns too?
Hehe! I can keep up!

zh: 你猜我会从哪边超过去？
en: Guess which side I'll pass on.
A gap opened. What a coincidence.
Keep your composure through the turn.
Watch my cape on the next stretch.

zh: 过了弯夸我一句好不好？
en: Come on, let's race together!
Praise me after the bend, okay?

tease.en: Your mouth is faster than your horse!

cheer.en: Hehe! Good luck to you too!

tease.en: Huh? I didn't lose that one!
Easy. I haven't made my move.

en: Fire it up!
Make room for me!
How's that for impact?
Take that! Keep up!
Whoa, you actually rammed me!
Give me a second!
Caught it! My turn!
Now that was clean!
One breath, then I'll be back!
The fire isn't out yet!
Switching to efficient overdrive.
Holding output. Starting my sprint.
Contact confirmed. Moving on.
The line is open now.
Contact taken. Recalculating.
Steady the pace first.
Timing correct. Energy restored.
Counter complete. Hold the line.
Energy spent. Returning to pace.
Recharge. Try again at the next bend.
Hehe, let's give it a push!
Wow, we're really moving now!
Huh? That connected!
Hehe, coming through!
Whoa, you scared me!
Wait, who bumped me?
I know this one!
Hehe, I caught it!
Phew. Where did my energy go?
A tiny breather!
Hehe. My turn now.
Think you can stop me? Try.
Did you see that coming?
Blocking me has a price.
Heh. You've got some skill.
Oh? Was that your second trick?
Hehe. I saw it coming.
Here. Right back at you.
You can breathe for now.
Heh. We'll try again later.
Watch what composure looks like.
Goldie, show them.
That clears the way.
Coming through. Mind my cape.
Manners still apply on the track.
Hmph. I'll remember that.
Timing ought to be exact.
Now that's a proper counter.
Ease off. Keep your poise.
Save the pace for the next bend.
Hehe, here come the petals!
Patches, let's go!
Oops, let me through!
Hehe, my turn in front!
Hmph! No laughing if you bump me!
Ow! Just wait till I catch you!
Hehe, caught it!
Praise me! I timed it perfectly!
I'm out of energy. Wait for me!
That's enough petals for now!

approach.zh: 别挡道！前面就是我的主场！
approach.en: Out of my way! This track is mine!

en: Try to keep up, Red!
Nice run, Red!
Red, give me a push?

approach.zh: 你这条路线还能再快一点。
approach.en: There’s a faster line through here.

zh: 蓝骑，再算算我会从哪超。
en: Predict my next move, Blue.
Clean line, Blue.
Blue, can we pick up the pace?

approach.zh: 追上你啦！这个弯一起过？
approach.en: Caught you! Take this turn together?

en: Can you keep up, Green?
You’re running well, Green!
Green, let’s sprint together?

approach.zh: 呵呵，猜猜我会从哪边超过你。
approach.en: Heh. Guess which side I’ll pass on.

zh: 紫骑，这次你的花招不灵。
en: No tricks this time, Purple.
Nice pass, Purple.
Purple, how about a boost?

approach.zh: 借过。希望我没打乱你的节奏。
approach.en: Passing through. I hope I haven’t upset your pace.

zh: 黄骑，我可不会让你轻松赢。
黄骑，这一段跑得很优雅。
en: I won’t make it easy, Gold.
Elegant riding, Gold.
Gold, may I ask for a boost?

approach.en: Caught you! Can I get a compliment?

en: Watch me pass, Pink!
That was great, Pink!
Pink, a little push, please?

success.zh: 行！后半程我推你一把，可别落后了！
success.en: Deal! I will push you late—just keep up!

fail.zh: 少来这套！想赢就靠实力跑过去！
fail.en: Forget it! Beat me with real speed!

success.zh: 约定成立。后段我会按计划给你一次加速。
success.en: Agreed. One planned boost in the final stretch.

fail.zh: 代价太高，这笔交易不在我的计划里。
fail.en: Too risky. That deal is not in my plan.

success.zh: 好呀好呀，后半程顺手推你一下也没关系～
success.en: Sure thing! Happy to give you a push later~

fail.zh: 哎呀，这个还是算了吧，开心比赛最重要嘛。
fail.en: Ah, better not—racing for fun matters more!

success.zh: 呵呵，有意思。后半程可别错过我的信号。
success.en: Heh, interesting. Do not miss my signal late.

fail.zh: 这点金币可打动不了我，还是收回去吧。
fail.en: That small offer will not move me. Keep your coins.

success.zh: 成交。能用金币解决的事，本就很优雅。
success.en: Done. Anything gold can settle is quite elegant.

fail.zh: 抱歉，我的名次可不是这么点金币能换的。
fail.en: Sorry, my placement is not for sale at that price.

success.zh: 好呀！后半程我会偷偷帮你加速一次的！
success.en: Okay! I will sneak you a boost later on!

fail.zh: 唔……这样好像不太好呢，金币还是还给你吧。
fail.en: Um... that feels a bit wrong. Here are your coins back.

accept.zh: 痛快！待会儿赛道上见，别忘了给我加速！
accept.en: Awesome! See you on the track—do not forget my boost!

decline.zh: 行吧，那就在赛道上靠实力一决胜负！
decline.en: Fine by me! Let us settle it fair and square on the track!

accept.zh: 很好，合作方案已确认。比赛里等你的助推。
accept.en: Good. Cooperation confirmed—I will watch for your boost.

decline.zh: 明白了。我按原计划推进，赛道上见。
decline.en: Understood. Sticking to my original plan. See you out there.

accept.zh: 太好啦！那我们比赛里一起照应咯～
accept.en: Great! Let us look out for each other out there~

decline.zh: 没关系没关系，大家各跑各的也很开心呀！
decline.en: No worries at all! Racing our own way is fun too!

accept.zh: 呵呵，很不错的选择。别忘了我们的约定。
accept.en: Heh, wise choice. Do not forget our little deal.

decline.zh: 真可惜，你刚刚错过了一笔好交易呢。
decline.en: What a pity—you just passed up a very good deal.

accept.zh: 很有眼光。等我拿下冠军，奖金少不了你的。
accept.en: Good eye. When I take first, your share will be waiting.

decline.zh: 拒绝我也没关系，待会儿在终点看我冲线吧。
decline.en: Decline if you wish—watch me cross the line first.

accept.zh: 太好了！那比赛的时候一定要帮我加速哦！
accept.en: Yay! Please remember to give me a boost in the race!

decline.zh: 唔……好吧，那我自己也会加油跑完的！
decline.en: Aw... okay, I will still try my very best on my own!
